title: Mythos Orchestrator Result
description: Structured completion report a provider must emit. This file is ALSO handed to `codex exec --output-schema`, so it is deliberately restricted to the structured-output subset: every property is required, additionalProperties is false everywhere, nullability is expressed as a type union, and no `pattern`/`minLength` keywords are used. Stricter semantic checks (SHA shape, commit existence, test evidence) belong to verifier.js, never to this file.

task_id.description: Must equal the task_id of the task that was dispatched.

status.description: Report 'completed' only when every required test actually ran and passed and every required delivery step was performed. Missing or uncertain evidence is never 'completed'.

blocked_reason.description: Required whenever status is 'blocked'; null otherwise. Use 'approval_required' when a needed shell command could not be approved non-interactively.

baseline.description: The commit the work actually started from.

implementation_commit.description: Full 40-character SHA of the implementation commit, or null if nothing was committed.

remote_head.description: Branch head on origin after pushing, or null if nothing was pushed.

tests.description: One entry per required test. Never claim a test passed without having run it.

output_summary.description: Short factual result, e.g. '45/45 passed'. Never paste environment variables or credentials.

summary.description: Two or three factual sentences. No secrets, no tokens, no environment dumps.
